1.name: visit house after funeral
1.description: A week after Rosa's funeral, the Serrano family house is shown as recently emptied and still marked by her presence.
evidence: A week after the funeral, the Serrano row house on Spruce still smelled faintly of the eucalyptus oil the matriarch had rubbed into her wrists each morning, and the kitchen calendar was turned to a month she had not lived to see.

1.name: Asha enters with executor key
1.description: Asha lets herself into the house using the key provided by the executor and heads upstairs to search Rosa's room.
evidence: Asha let herself in with the key the executor had given her and went straight upstairs, past the front parlor where buyers had already walked through twice, toward the narrow back bedroom where Rosa had slept the last two years.

1.name: Asha searches Rosa's bedroom
1.description: Asha carefully searches the bedroom for a hidden codicil or other important document.
evidence: She moved carefully there, opening the nightstand, lifting the folded altar cloth from the top of the dresser, checking the underside of a framed photograph for anything tucked behind the backing; if a codicil existed, this was the room a woman would hide it in for the daughter-in-law who had stayed.

1.name: Daniel searches mother's desk
1.description: Daniel methodically empties his mother's writing desk and inspects it for hidden papers.
evidence: Down the hall, Daniel was already at his mother's writing desk, pulling each drawer fully out and turning it over, sliding a hand along the empty runners and then under the desk itself, working with the brisk competence of a man who did not want to be doing this slowly.

1.name: Daniel finds ordinary papers only
1.description: Daniel discovers routine documents but no message or bequest addressed to him.
evidence: He found insurance receipts, a Mass card, a rubber-banded stack of unopened bank statements, and nothing in his mother's hand addressed to him.

1.name: Daniel resents Asha's search
1.description: When Daniel hears Asha upstairs in Rosa's part of the house, he feels a quiet refusal and does not ask what she is doing.
evidence: When he heard Asha's step overhead, in Rosa's part of the house, he did not call up to ask what she was looking for, and the small refusal settled in him before he could name it.

1.name: Asha approaches Daniel
1.description: Asha comes down the hall toward Daniel, stopping at a careful distance before speaking or acting further.
evidence: Asha came down the hall before Daniel could finish framing the question for himself, stopping a careful arm's length from the wr

1.name: Daniel hesitates before asking
1.description: Daniel feels a small refusal rising in him before he can fully articulate the question he is about to ask.
evidence: the small refusal settled in him before he could name it

1.name: Asha confronts Daniel at the desk
1.description: Asha approaches the writing desk and asks Daniel why he is searching the drawer so thoroughly.
evidence: Asha came down the hall before Daniel could finish framing the question for himself, stopping a careful arm's length from the writing desk where the bottom drawer lay overturned on the rug.
She kept her voice level and asked him why he was searching it quite so thoroughly

1.name: Daniel conceals his search
1.description: Daniel avoids answering directly, resets the drawer, and asks Asha whether she has seen any old papers upstairs in his mother's room.
evidence: Daniel did not look up at once; he slid the drawer back onto its runners, then straightened and asked, with the same studied lightness, whether she'd come across any old papers upstairs in his mother's room.

1.name: Asha notices Daniel's implication
1.description: Asha recognizes that Daniel's use of the word 'old' reveals more than he intends.
evidence: The word old did the work he wanted it to do and gave too much away at the same time, and Asha registered both in the half second before she answered.

1.name: Asha denies finding papers upstairs
1.description: Asha says she found nothing upstairs, including anything hidden in a book or under a drawer liner.
evidence: Asha said evenly that she hadn't found anything upstairs, nothing folded into a book or slid under a drawer liner

1.name: Asha questions Daniel's suspicion
1.description: Asha asks Daniel why he believes there would be hidden papers to find in his mother's room.
evidence: and then asked him why he thought there would be papers like that to find.

1.name: Daniel presses for old papers again
1.description: Daniel steps back from the desk and repeats his question more carefully, emphasizing that he means specifically old papers.
evidence: Daniel stepped back from the desk, one hand still resting on the corner where the bank statements were stacked, and gave her a tight, closed smile before he asked again, more carefully this time, whether she'd come across anything specifically old in his mother's room.
The repetition of the word told her what the first use had only suggested

1.name: Asha infers Daniel seeks a specific document
1.description: Asha realizes Daniel's repeated mention of something old means he is looking for a particular document and thinks she may already have it.
evidence: The repetition of the word told her what the first use had only suggested, that he was looking for a particular document and believed she might already be holding it.

1.name: Asha delays her answer
1.description: Asha pauses before answering Daniel, watching his smile stay fixed while she gauges his intentions.
evidence: She let the answer wait a beat longer than was comfortable, watching the smile hold itself in place

1.name: Asha notices Daniel avoids naming the document
1.description: Asha observes that Daniel has not denied expecting something, but has refused to say what it is.
evidence: noted that he had not denied expecting something, only declined to name it

1.name: Overturned drawer remains as evidence
1.description: The overturned drawer on the rug underscores that something has been searched or disturbed, and neither person is ready to address it.
evidence: Between them the overturned drawer lay on the rug like evidence neither of them was ready to discuss

1.name: Asha asks which old paper Daniel wants
1.description: Asha directly asks Daniel which specific old paper he expects to find.
evidence: Asha kept her face still and asked him which old paper, exactly, he expected to find.

1.name: Daniel avoids answering directly
1.description: Daniel refuses to identify the paper and instead shifts the conversation away from the question.
evidence: Daniel did not answer it directly.

1.name: Daniel hides the bank statements
1.description: Daniel picks up the rubber-banded bundle of bank statements and places it behind him on a chair, removing it from Asha's reach.
evidence: Instead he gathered the rubber-banded bundle off the corner of the desk, set it on the chair behind him as though tidying
the bank statements moved out of her reach

1.name: Daniel steps back and probes upstairs rooms
1.description: Daniel retreats from the desk and asks whether Asha has searched other upstairs rooms, including the linen closet and cedar chest.
evidence: and stepped back from the furniture with a smile that did not reach the rest of his face
He asked, with the same careful lightness he had used before, whether there were other rooms upstairs she hadn't gone through yet, the linen closet maybe, the cedar chest at the foot of the bed

1.name: Asha registers Daniel's evasiveness
1.description: Asha mentally catalogs Daniel's fixed smile, the moved bank statements, and his continued refusal to name what he wants.
evidence: Asha noted the smile, and the bank statements moved out of her reach, and the fact that he had again declined to name what he was looking for

1.name: Asha notices Daniel's evasiveness
1.description: Asha observes Daniel's smile, the removed bank statements, and his refusal to say what he is looking for, while staying silent.
evidence: Asha noted the smile, and the bank statements moved out of her reach, and the fact that he had again declined to name what he was looking for, and she let the hallway hold all three things without remarking on any of them.

1.name: Asha denies searching hidden rooms
1.description: Asha says she has not been in the linen closet or cedar chest and challenges Daniel to explain why he suspects those places.
evidence: Asha did not move toward the stairs. She said she hadn't been in the linen closet or the cedar chest, then asked him, in the same procedural voice she had used about the drawer, why those rooms in particular came to mind.

1.name: Daniel explains his suspicion
1.description: Daniel offers a plausible story that his mother hid things in linens and other unlikely places.
evidence: Daniel held his smile a beat too long before stepping further back from the desk, his hand finally leaving the corner where the bank statements had been, and offered that his mother used to tuck things into linens, sweaters, anywhere except the places a person would think to look.

1.name: Asha recognizes Daniel's prepared excuse
1.description: Asha realizes Daniel had a ready explanation for the linen closet but not for the desk he already searched.
evidence: The answer was almost reasonable, and that was what Asha noted: that he had a story ready for the linen closet but had not had one ready for the desk he'd already overturned.

1.name: Asha approaches the statements
1.description: Asha slowly reaches toward the chair with the rubber-banded bank statements, keeping her expression neutral.
evidence: Asha took one slow step toward the chair where Daniel had set the rubber-banded statements, her hand half-extended, her face arranged into the same neutral she had used for the drawer.

1.name: Daniel blocks Asha's reach
1.description: Daniel shifts to intercept Asha and resumes his smile before she can take the statements.
evidence: Daniel's weight shifted to intercept her, the smile coming back too quickly

1.name: Rosa interrupts the confrontation
1.description: Rosa emerges from the hallway carrying a folded dish towel and clears her throat to speak before Asha and Daniel can continue.
evidence: before either of them spoke, Rosa stepped from the dim end of the hall where the eucalyptus smell was thickest, a folded dish towel still in her hands. She cleared her throat

1.name: Rosa confronts Daniel about the linen closet
1.description: Rosa steps out from the hallway and asks Daniel why he has suddenly become interested in the linen closet after ignoring it for years.
evidence: Rosa stepped from the dim end of the hall where the eucalyptus smell was thickest, a folded dish towel still in her hands.
She cleared her throat and asked Daniel, plainly, why the linen closet had become so interesting to him this week when he had not opened it once in the years his mother was alive.

1.name: Daniel hesitates under scrutiny
1.description: Daniel freezes mid-motion as Rosa questions him, while Asha waits to see whether he will answer Rosa or her first.
evidence: Daniel's hand stopped halfway to the chair.
Asha did not pick up the bundle yet; she only let her fingers stay near it, and watched him decide whether to answer the housekeeper or the daughter first.

1.name: Asha takes the bundle from the chair
1.description: Asha moves up to the chair and lifts the rubber-banded bundle off it without rushing, keeping her attention on Daniel.
evidence: Asha closed the last few inches of distance to the chair and lifted the rubber-banded bundle off the seat without hurrying, her eyes on Daniel rather than on the statements in her hand.

1.name: Daniel loses his blocking position
1.description: Daniel's attempt to block Asha fails, leaving him awkward and unable to respond cleanly.
evidence: Daniel's weight had been set to step into her path, and now he had nowhere clean to put it;
the hand that had reached after her hung at his side and then went, uselessly, to the back of his neck.

1.name: Rosa accuses Daniel of lying
1.description: Watching Daniel's discomfort, Rosa asks who taught him to lie with such a polite smile.
evidence: From the dim end of the hallway Rosa folded the dish towel slowly over her knuckles, watching the way his shoulders had reorganized themselves, and asked him who had taught him to lie with such a polite smile.

1.name: Daniel refuses to answer
1.description: Daniel stays silent as the tension between the three of them sharpens.
evidence: Daniel did not answer;

1.name: Asha senses the bundle matters less than Daniel's delay
1.description: Asha realizes that Daniel's effort to keep the bundle from her is more revealing than whatever the bundle contains.
evidence: Asha felt the bundle in her palm and understood, without having opened it yet, that whatever was inside would matter less than the seconds he had just spent trying to keep it from her.

1.name: Asha opens the rubber-banded bundle
1.description: Asha removes the rubber band and begins to fan through the papers inside the bundle.
evidence: Asha slid the rubber band off with her thumb and let it drop onto the chair seat, fanning the state

1.name: Asha inspects the bank statements
1.description: Asha removes the rubber band and fans through the statements, searching for missing months and unfamiliar handwriting.
evidence: Asha slid the rubber band off with her thumb and let it drop onto the chair seat, fanning the statements just enough to read the corners, her eyes lifting back to Daniel between each page.
She was looking for the months that should have been there and weren't, for any handwriting that didn't belong to a bank

1.name: Daniel remains tense and motionless
1.description: Daniel watches Asha examine the statements with a rigid stillness, as if any movement would worsen the situation.
evidence: Daniel watched her do it with the stillness of a man who has decided that moving will only make it worse

1.name: Rosa brings up the blue folder
1.description: Rosa steps into view, sets down a dish towel, and asks Daniel whether he remembers the blue folder in the attic.
evidence: Before he found whatever sentence he was assembling, Rosa stepped further into the light, set the folded dish towel down on the small table by the hall mirror, and asked him, without raising her voice, whether he remembered the blue folder in the attic, the one his mother kept on the shelf above the winter coats.

1.name: Daniel lowers his hand from his neck
1.description: Rosa's question causes Daniel to slowly drop the hand at the back of his neck, signaling his discomfort.
evidence: The hand at the back of his neck came down slowly.

1.name: Asha withholds a response
1.description: Asha keeps reading without looking up, but her stillness and widened silence force Daniel to answer for himself.
evidence: Asha did not look up from the statements, but her thumb stopped moving on the page, and she let the silence widen so he would have to step into it himself.

1.name: Asha demands the folder's location
1.description: Asha looks Daniel in the eye and asks where exactly the blue folder is in the attic.
evidence: Asha lifted her eyes from the fanned pages and held Daniel's gaze across the narrow hall, the rubber band still curled on the chair seat between them.
"The blue folder," she said, flat as a clerk reading a docket. "Where exactly in the attic?"

1.name: Daniel deflects Rosa's question
1.description: Daniel gives a strained laugh and turns to Rosa, trying to suggest she may be mistaken about the folder and its shelf.
evidence: Daniel let out a short laugh that didn't reach anywhere near his eyes and turned his head toward Rosa, asking whether she was sure she wasn't thinking of some other shelf, some other year

1.name: Daniel deflects Rosa's concern
1.description: Daniel gives a short laugh and turns toward Rosa, implying she may be mistaken about which shelf or year the folder belongs to.
evidence: out a short laugh that didn't reach anywhere near his eyes and turned his head toward Rosa, asking whether she was sure she wasn't thinking of some other shelf, some other year, his mother had kept so many folders.

1.name: Rosa stays silent
1.description: Rosa does not answer Daniel and instead keeps her hand resting on the folded towel by the mirror.
evidence: Rosa did not answer; she only let her hand rest on the folded towel by the mirror

1.name: Asha notices Daniel shifting toward Rosa
1.description: Asha observes Daniel shifting his weight toward Rosa, reading it as an attempt to discredit the person who has lived in the house longest.
evidence: Asha noted the second small movement of his, the way his weight shifted again toward Rosa instead of toward her, as if the easier person to discredit was the one who had lived in the house longest.

1.name: Asha waits on missing statement
1.description: Asha remains poised over the page where the March statement should be, while the eucalyptus smell lingers unchanged.
evidence: The eucalyptus smell had not moved, and neither had Asha's thumb on the page where the March statement should have been.

1.name: Asha asks about the blue folder
1.description: Asha asks whether the blue folder is still in the attic, speaking in a way that forces Daniel to answer directly.
evidence: "Is the blue folder still in the attic?" Asha asked, stepping past Daniel's shifted weight without looking at him, her voice flat enough that the question landed as a fact he would have to dispute rather than a query he could deflect.

1.name: Daniel tries to turn back to Rosa
1.description: Daniel begins to angle his face back toward Rosa with a strained smile, but is prevented from redirecting the exchange.
evidence: Daniel started to angle his face back toward Rosa, the strained smile already half-built, but Rosa did not give it anywhere to go

1.name: Rosa confirms the attic location
1.description: Rosa looks only at Asha and nods toward the ceiling, signaling that the blue folder is in the attic above the winter coats.
evidence: she looked only at Asha and tipped her chin once toward the ceiling, the small definite movement of a person who had carried laundry up those stairs for thirty years and knew exactly which board creaked under the shelf above the winter coats.

1.name: Asha accepts Rosa's confirmation
1.description: Asha catches Rosa's nod and holds onto it, treating it as decisive evidence.
evidence: Asha caught the nod and held it

1.name: Daniel loses control of the exchange
1.description: The interaction shifts against Daniel as he touches his neck and his authority in the house weakens.
evidence: and something in the hallway rearranged itself: Daniel's hand went back to his neck, and the second small certainty in the house was no longer his.

1.name: Asha takes the statements and moves on
1.description: Asha tucks the bank statements under her arm, preparing to act on the information she has gained.
evidence: Asha tucked the bank statements under her arm

1.name: Asha takes the bank statements upstairs
1.description: Asha turns toward the stairs carrying the bank statements, leaving Daniel behind.
evidence: Asha tucked the bank statements under her arm and turned toward the stairs.

1.name: Daniel yields the stairway
1.description: Daniel steps back against the wainscoting to let Asha pass, still unsure whether to follow or explain himself.
evidence: on the third tread he stepped back against the wainscoting to let her past, the strained almost-smile still fixed on his face as if he hadn't decided yet whether to follow or to stay and explain.

1.name: Rosa watches Daniel at the stairs
1.description: Rosa follows Asha to the foot of the stairs and fixes her attention on Daniel instead of going up.
evidence: Rosa moved after Asha to the foot of the stairs and stopped there, the folded towel left behind on the table, her eyes set on Daniel rather than on the climb, and Daniel did not try the smile on her again.

1.name: Asha climbs the narrow stairwell
1.description: Asha ascends the worn stairwell toward the attic, passing through the lingering smell of old wood.
evidence: The narrow stairwell smelled less of eucalyptus and more of old wood as Asha rose, the runner worn pale down the center where thirty years of laundry baskets had gone up and come down.

1.name: Asha enters the attic
1.description: Asha reaches the top of the stairs and finds an unlatched attic door leading into a low-ceilinged space.
evidence: She found the half-landing, the second flight, and at the top a low door already unlatched; through it the slope of the attic ceiling and, against the far wall, the shelf above a rod of heavy winter coats that still held the shape of the woman who had hung them.

1.name: Asha approaches the shelf above the coats
1.description: Asha ducks under the attic ceiling and goes straight to the shelf above the winter coats, intent on reaching something there.
evidence: Asha ducked under the slope of the ceiling and went straight to the shelf above the winter coats, the bank statements still flat under her arm, the dust on the boards muffling her steps.

1.name: Asha strains to reach the shelf
1.description: Because the shelf is set for Rosa's height, Asha has to rise onto her toes and reach past a hatbox to get to it.
evidence: The shelf sat at eye level for someone Rosa's height; for Asha it meant lifting onto the balls of her feet and reaching past a hatbox to th

1.name: Asha retrieves hidden blue folder
1.description: Asha reaches past a hatbox on the attic shelf and pulls out a stiff blue folder hidden behind other items.
evidence: her fingers found the squared corner of something stiffer than cardboard
Asha drew the folder out into the light to see that it was, in fact, blue

1.name: Rosa watches Daniel from below
1.description: Rosa remains at the foot of the stairs, holding the towel and staring at Daniel in the hallway instead of following Asha upward.
evidence: Below, at the foot of the stairs, Rosa had not moved; she stood with the towel left behind on the table and her eyes set on Daniel in the hallway

1.name: Daniel holds still under Rosa's gaze
1.description: Daniel feels Rosa's stare and stays frozen where she left him, hand at his neck and weight unmoving.
evidence: Daniel felt the look enough that his hand stayed at his neck and his weight stayed where she had placed it

1.name: Asha enters the cold attic
1.description: Asha stands in the attic's cold, quiet air and prepares to inspect the folder she has found.
evidence: The attic was quieter than the hall had been, no eucalyptus here, only old wood and wool and the faint cold that came off the slates
Asha drew the folder out into the light

1.name: Asha checks for interruption before opening folder
1.description: Before opening the folder, Asha listens for someone coming up the stairs and hears only the attic settling.
evidence: Asha glanced once toward the low attic door before she opened the folder, listening for a foot on the half-landing and hearing only the slight tick of cooling slate above her

1.name: Asha reads hidden estate document
1.description: Asha examines the papers in the folder and realizes the loose page is a typed document dated four months before the death and signed shakily.
evidence: The papers inside were thinner than she had expected, two stapled sheets clipped over a single loose page typed in a different machine, dated four months before the death and signed in a hand that had gone shakier than the will downstairs
She read the loose page twice

1.name: Asha discovers house left to Rosa
1.description: Asha learns from the document that the house was left to Rosa, with Daniel and his sister to share the remainder of the estate equally.
evidence: the line that mattered was plain: the house was to go to Rosa Delacruz, who had remained in residence and provided care, with Daniel to receive the remainder of the estate in equal share with his sister

1.name: will assigns house to Rosa
1.description: The will states that the house goes to Rosa Delacruz because she remained in residence and provided care.
evidence: the house was to go to Rosa Delacruz, who had remained in residence and provided care

1.name: will leaves remainder to Daniel and sister
1.description: The will gives Daniel the remainder of the estate in equal share with his sister.
evidence: Daniel to receive the remainder of the estate in equal share with his sister

1.name: Rosa watches Daniel silently
1.description: Rosa remains still at the foot of the stairs, staring at Daniel without moving.
evidence: Rosa had not shifted her weight or her eyes; she kept her gaze on Daniel
At the foot of the stairs Rosa held her place, her eyes still on Daniel

1.name: Daniel hesitates at the stairs
1.description: Daniel keeps his hand at his neck and does not try to move past Rosa toward the stairs.
evidence: Daniel, his hand still at his neck, did not try to step around her toward the climb

1.name: Asha closes folder and descends
1.description: Asha closes the blue folder, presses it against the bank statements, and comes down from the attic without looking back.
evidence: Asha closed the blue folder over the loose page, pressed it flat against the bank statements under her arm, and ducked back beneath the slope of the ceiling without a glance at the shelf or the coats that had kept its shape
She came down the second flight evenly

1.name: Asha avoids Daniel and attic
1.description: As she descends, Asha avoids looking at the attic door or Daniel waiting in the hall.
evidence: did not look up at the attic door behind her or down at Daniel waiting in the hall

1.name: Rosa retrieves and folds towel
1.description: Rosa reaches back for the towel she left on the table and folds it carefully along its old creases.
evidence: only when Asha reached the half-landing did she reach back to the table for the towel she had left there, folding it once and then again along its old creases

1.name: Daniel notices folder and Rosa's gesture
1.description: Daniel sees Asha's folder and Rosa's precise towel-folding, while his own posture remains tense and fixed.
evidence: Daniel saw the folder under Asha's arm and the small, exact motion of Rosa's hands and kept his own hand at his neck, the almost-smile gone now, his weight still set where Rosa had set it

1.name: Asha stops at half-landing
1.description: Asha pauses at the half-landing with the folder and bank statements held at her side.
evidence: At the half-landing Asha stopped, the blue folder pressed flat against the bank statements at her side

1.name: Asha stops on the half-landing
1.description: Asha halts on the stair landing, holding the blue folder against the bank statements as she looks down toward Daniel.
evidence: At the half-landing Asha stopped, the blue folder pressed flat against the bank statements at her side, and looked down past the runner to where Daniel still stood

1.name: Asha confronts Daniel about the changed will
1.description: Asha asks Daniel why he did not tell her that someone changed it four months before death, implying a concealed alteration of the will or document.
evidence: "Why didn't you tell me she changed it four months before she died," she said, not as a question

1.name: Daniel hesitates to respond
1.description: Daniel twitches at his neck and swallows his reply, leaving his prepared words unsaid.
evidence: Daniel's hand twitched at his neck and did not lower; whatever he had readied to say stayed behind his teeth

1.name: Rosa finishes folding the towel
1.description: Rosa completes folding the towel and sets it on the table before speaking.
evidence: Rosa, without turning her head, finished the second fold of the towel and laid it on the table

1.name: Rosa rebukes Daniel
1.description: Rosa tells Daniel that the time for smiles is over, signaling a hardening of the situation.
evidence: "The time for smiles is over, Daniel."
